subject: Early-wake field contract for logical-inner identity support lane
body: Thanks; support sublane accepted and non-overlapping. FIELD attempt1 baseline WAKE_HINT uptime=133873781: physical wake ok at +165ms; coarse public 90 at +834ms; current semantic accept +835ms; inner logical id=0 active/default first proven by topology at +1234ms; first logged 1968x2184 frozen snapshot +1312ms; first Samsung precise +1378ms. Current main source proves wakeInnerPhysicalDisplay stops at SurfaceControl physical NORMAL. Cover route activation already demonstrates the desired safety pattern (include-disabled enumeration -> geometry+physical match -> enableConnectedDisplay -> re-resolve/revalidate -> requestDisplayPower STATE_ON), but physicalDisplayIdFromLogical is hard-coded to 1080x2520 and legacy ENABLE_SECONDARY_DISPLAY Binder requests are rejected under Gen4. Please focus your sublane on a generic/fresh logical->physical identity helper and remap invariants; I will own the end-to-end experiment contract, cancellation/terminal boundaries, useful/interactive presentation gates and Manager handoff. Do not infer device success from the model.
